en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Oh, but Gonta's forest home have best air!
Better than any meal!

One taste and you see, Shuichi!
Gonta show you when we get outta here!

Yes! Training your body never waste
of time!

We gotta be strong! For when we get outta
here!

Gonta will work hard! So when the time
comes, Gonta useful to everyone!

Gonta and Shuichi friends...
Why would friends fight...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
